yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm do a little dance? 🕺 Cocktail Sort, also known as bidirectional bubble sort, is here to shake, rattle, and roll your unsorted array into perfect order! Watch as it moves both forwards AND backwards, like a bartender mixing the perfect drink. 🍹 We'll break down its steps, show you a super cool visualization, and discuss why this quirky sort might just be the most entertaining! 

Is Cocktail Sort efficient? 🤔 Is it practical? 

Join us as we dive deep into this fascinating sorting algorithm! #CocktailSort #AlgorithmVisualization #DataStructures #ComputerScience #CodingTutorial #LearnToCode #Programming #TechExplained #ViralCoding
